main_text.head: EXERC. XV.
VTRVM PARTI SIMILARIS NOSTRI CORPORIS TRIA MORBORVM GENERA INSIDEANT?
main_text.p: SVperioribus philosophicis quaestionibus solutis, ad alias, quę ad medicinam spectant, nos progredi licet. Propterea in primis quaeritur an similaris pars quaelibet nostri corporis triplici morborum genere, nempe morbo materiae, formę & temperamenti affici possit? Omnes autem tum antiqui, tum recentiores medici, praeter unum Fernelium, alioqui virū philosophum & egregium medicum, partes nostri corporis similares uno duntaxat proprio morbo, videlicet intemperie simplici, aut composita, nuda, solaq;, vel cum quopiam humore, flatuve coiuncta affici, & altero utriusque parti, & similari & dissimilari communi, quem continuti[?] dissolutionem vocant medici, profitentur. Verum FerneliusCap.7. lib. de Morborum differentiis, & secundo de Abditis rerū causis, propria morborum genera praeter communem unicuiq; parti similari insidere statuit, materiae videlicet immoderationem, temperamenti intemperiem,

page.notes: The "»" marks in the left margin beside the last four lines are printer's quotation marks, not text, so they are left out. "continuti" may be "continui"; I have kept the printed form and marked it. "formę & temperamenti" and "affici possit?" are read with some uncertainty from a small, slightly blurred print. The drop cap S is joined to the word "Vperioribus". The heading words are small and set in a distinctive typeface; "INSIDEANT?" is set in italic. The page is otherwise clean, with show-through from the reverse side only.
